race.description: Whyte Just & Moore Lawyers Avoca Cup Hcp
race.comment: OMNIC (7) hardly runs a bad race, and though he does not win often, he probably should have scored last time out in the Coleraine Cup, instead he had to settle for an unlucky second, his fifth such position in a row since winning fresh up. On top for us. TIKEMYSON (4) has had a couple of subtle gear changes since his last start in the Hamilton Cup last week, where he overdid it outside the leader that day. A good track will help him, and he is worth another chance. RAF ATTACK (1) has yet to feature in 3 starts back from a spell, but this is his right level, and a form reversal is on the cards. FOX APPEAL (2) is heading the right way with his form this season, and he maps to get the run of the race from the pole position. Each way value in this. VERONA RUPES (6) was a solid neck winner in lesser company at Mildura 11 days ago, and with 5.5kg less to carry here, she should be included in all top 4 combos.
